name: Xapo Bank Card
summary: Xapo Bank Card is a premium Bitcoin banking card with 1% BTC cashback, zero FX fees, and industry-low 0.1% BTC spread. Part of a licensed Gibraltar private bank with $1,000/year membership.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required

faq.question: Does the Xapo Bank Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$83.33 per month. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Xapo Bank Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the Xapo Bank Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
